newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr weakens against the dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr marginally fell against the dollar on Monday, the central National Bank of Ethiopia said.
The bank quoted the birr at a commerical mean rate of 6.37 against the dollar compared to 6.36 last week.

"The applicable rate for all transactions outside the currency auction between September 23 and 29 would be 6.37 to the dollar," the National Bank of Ethiopia said following the currency auction held on September 28.
The bank also posted the following birr-international currency rates on Monday.
Birr-pound at 9.895, birr-mark at 4.2040, birr-Italian lire at 0.004177, birr-French franc at 1.2406, birr-Japanese yen at 0.058025 and birr-Kenyan shilling at 0.1135.
